provenance.translation: Direct translation of the public Japanese guide. Original guide sources remain in its metadata.

stageName.text: Into the Darkness, Floor 2: Right Atrium

lead.text: Defeat summoned Green Slimes before they are eaten, then focus the Pearl when the boss's slime runs out. Avoid repeatedly attacking the resistant Shell, and prepare for Larva's SP loss and the area attack every 4 turns.

listLead.text: Defeat summoned Green Slimes before they are eaten, then focus the vulnerable Part when the boss's slime runs out. Avoid repeatedly attacking the resistant Shell, and prepare for Larva's SP loss and the area attack every 4 turns.

statNote.text: Overall HP is 1229; Pearl HP is 774 and Shell HP is 431. Part HP is not added to determine overall HP. The summoned 25-HP Green Slimes are separate units. Listed resistances are normal values, separate from changes caused by the special Stagger at 0 slime or Part breaks. Ishmael must deploy while alive and cannot be replaced with a Support Identity. Noose assists her to Level 40 and Uptie/Threadspin IV. She begins each fight at -25 SP, so do not rely on her alone for strong opening Clashes or costly E.G.O.

priorities.0.text: Defeat the 25-HP Green Slimes before the boss eats them.

priorities.1.text: Win against Larva-inflicting attacks to protect SP.

priorities.2.text: Focus the Pearl during the opening at 0 slime.

troubleshooting.0.symptom.text: The enemy is too resistant to damage

troubleshooting.0.advice.text: All Shell resistances are 0.7 and remain unchanged on Stagger. Defeat summoned slimes to prevent replenishment, then focus the Pearl during the special Stagger triggered by 0 slime.

troubleshooting.1.advice.text: Larva deals SP damage equal to its value at Turn Start and transfers to the ally with the highest current HP at Turn End. Prioritize winning against Corrosive Slime and Paralytic Fluid. Devouring Fluid also applies Larva [On Use], so Clash wins cannot prevent all of it.

troubleshooting.2.advice.text: Successful Predation on a summoned slime restores 3 stacks. Defeat it first with a faster attack. The area attack every 4 turns and recovery from the special Stagger also restore 10, so Predation is not the only cause.

phases.0.title.text: Prepare healing and enough actions to defeat slimes

phases.0.steps.0.text: Recommended Level 40; deploy 6 Sinners. Account for Ishmael's low SP by giving other main units strong Clashes and healing options.

phases.0.steps.1.text: Consider Wrath/Pride damage against the boss and area attacks for multiple summons. Prioritize winning against Larva-inflicting attacks rather than building solely to damage the resistant Shell.

phases.0.steps.2.text: Save HP and SP recovery. Poison's HP damage and Larva's SP loss require separate answers.

phases.1.title.text: Prioritize stopping skills that add Larva

phases.1.steps.0.text: Beat Corrosive Slime and Paralytic Fluid to limit Larva and Paralyze. Poisoned Sinners receive extra Paralyze or Defense Level Down, so assign healthier main units to these Clashes.

phases.1.steps.1.text: Devouring Fluid inflicts 3 Larva [On Use]. This remains even when you win, so use SP recovery and action cancellation from Part breaks too.

phases.1.steps.2.text: Green Slime is consumed at Combat Start. Winning the Clash does not cancel that consumption or next turn's summon.

phases.2.title.text: Defeat summons before the boss acts

phases.2.steps.0.text: Summoned slimes have 25 HP. Use faster Sinners or area attacks to prevent Turn End Poison and the boss's Predation.

phases.2.steps.1.text: Predation is unclashable and cannot be redirected. Instead of challenging its 50–51 roll with E.G.O, defeat the targeted slime first so the attack cannot resolve.

phases.2.steps.2.text: The boss's Green Slime status and the summoned units share a name but are separate. You do not directly attack the status to reduce its value.

phases.3.title.text: Focus the Pearl during the special Stagger opening

phases.3.steps.0.text: At Turn Start with 0 slime, the boss Staggers and the Pearl's resistances weaken. Focus strong attacks on the Pearl to reduce overall HP.

phases.3.steps.1.text: Staggering the Shell through ordinary attacks differs from the special Stagger at 0 slime. Its normal resistances are 0.7; avoid repeatedly attacking only the Shell.

phases.3.steps.2.text: Recovery from the special Stagger restores 10 slime. If the boss survives, clear summoned slimes again to create another opening.

phases.4.title.text: Save a strong area-attack answer, then finish the boss

phases.4.steps.0.text: Effervescent Green Slime rolls up to 25, with Attack Weight increasing according to the boss's slime. Save a powerful skill to stop its combined Poison, SP loss, and Larva application.

phases.4.steps.1.text: This area attack gains 10 slime at Combat Start. Winning the Clash does not prevent that replenishment.

phases.4.steps.2.text: At 10% overall HP or less, the boss repeatedly uses its area attack. If you can finish it, concentrate damage rather than chasing only summons.

mechanics.0.effect.text: The boss's status has a maximum of 10. When it decreases, summoned units with the same name appear next turn. There can be up to 3 summons, each with 25 HP. Predation on one restores 3 stacks.

mechanics.0.response.text: Distinguish the status from summoned units, and defeat the summons before Predation.

mechanics.1.effect.text: At Turn End, take HP damage equal to its value, then halve the value.

mechanics.1.response.text: Clear summoned slimes to limit further application, and save HP healing.

mechanics.2.effect.text: At Turn Start, take SP damage equal to its value. At Turn End, transfer to the ally with the highest current HP.

mechanics.2.response.text: Win against the skills applying it and use SP recovery. It does not remain only the first affected Sinner's problem.

mechanics.3.effect.text: A Canto V dungeon aid. Raises Ishmael to Level 40 if below 40 and assists Uptie/Threadspin to IV. Grants Compulsion each battle.

mechanics.3.response.text: Prepare other main units, resistances, and healing rather than rushing to raise only Ishmael.

mechanics.4.effect.text: Ishmael begins combat at -25 SP. At Turn Start, if SP is below 0, gain 3 Attack Power Up.

mechanics.4.response.text: Prioritize SP recovery and durability, and watch for E.G.O Corrosion at low SP.

warnings.0.text: The Shell retains its normal resistances on Stagger. Do not confuse this with the Pearl's special weakening.

warnings.1.text: Slime consumption and replenishment at Combat Start cannot be canceled by winning Clashes.

warnings.2.text: Devouring Fluid applies 3 Larva [On Use]. SP management remains necessary even if you stop all Attack Skills.

warnings.3.text: Successful Evades can also inflict Poison. Offset Overflowing Poison with another Defense Skill to avoid letting the enemy reuse it repeatedly.

preparation.0.text: Aim for the recommended Level 40. Use the dungeon aid for Ishmael, supporting her low opening SP with recovery or resistances.

preparation.1.text: Prepare powerful Clashes against Larva application, fast attacks or area damage for summons, and HP/SP recovery.

roles.0.reason.text: Stop the chain of SP loss.

roles.1.reason.text: Reduce Predation replenishment and Turn End Poison.

roles.2.reason.text: Use the 0-slime opening to reduce overall HP.

units.0.notes.0.text: Starts with 10 slime and consumes it through attacks' Combat Start effects.

units.0.notes.1.text: Remains targetable after breaking. Breaking the Part cancels its actions at that moment.

units.0.notes.2.text: At Turn Start with 0 slime, the boss enters a special Stagger and the Pearl's resistances weaken. Distinguish this from normal Stagger.

units.1.notes.0.text: Retains its normal resistances on Stagger. Ordinary Stagger does not make it dramatically easier to damage.

units.1.notes.1.text: Remains targetable after breaking. Breaking the Part cancels its actions at that moment.

units.2.notes.0.text: Up to 3. They do not act, but their Turn End passive inflicts Poison.

units.2.notes.1.text: The boss's Predation restores 3 slime when it eats one, so defeat it first.

units.2.notes.2.text: Automatically defeated when the boss dies. In the final stretch, consider finishing the boss instead.

skills.0.response.text: Win to prevent Poison on hit. Winning alone does not cancel Combat Start slime consumption or next turn's summon.

skills.1.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict Defense Level Down equal to the target's Poison.

skills.1.effects.3.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict Defense Level Down equal to the target's Poison.

skills.1.response.text: Inflicts Larva and Poison-based Defense Level Down. Its SP impact is greater than Toxic Fluid's, so assign a main unit who can win.

skills.2.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] If the target has Poison, inflict 1 Paralyze.

skills.2.effects.3.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] If the target has Poison, inflict 1 Paralyze.

skills.2.response.text: Each Coin applies 2 Larva. Poisoned targets also receive Paralyze, so prioritize stopping this Clash.

skills.3.response.text: A 2-Coin skill rolling up to 16. The 3 Larva applied [On Use] remains even if you win. Prevent Poison and next-turn Paralyze on hit, and prepare recovery.

skills.4.effects.0.text: [Combat Start] Increase Attack Weight by Green Slime's value.

skills.4.effects.5.text: [Heads Hit] Inflict 1 Paralyze and 3 Defense Level Down next turn.

skills.4.response.text: An area attack rolling up to 25. Slime-based Attack Weight and replenishment of 10 apply at Combat Start. Prevent hits with a strong Clash, then handle slimes after replenishment too.

skills.5.effects.2.text: Defeat Green Slime when attacking it.

skills.5.response.text: An unclashable, unredirectable attack that defeats a summoned slime. Use faster attacks to defeat its target and prevent replenishment rather than attempting to Clash with a Sinner.

skills.6.effects.0.text: [On Evade] Inflict 5 Poison on the target.

skills.6.response.text: Each successful Evade inflicts 5 Poison. Offset with a Defense Skill or break through with a strong attack; avoid unplanned weak multi-hit attacks.

skills.7.effects.0.text: [On Evade] Inflict 5 Poison on the target.

skills.7.response.text: Each successful Evade inflicts 5 Poison. Offset with a Defense Skill or break through with a strong attack; avoid unplanned weak multi-hit attacks.

passives.0.effect.text: At Turn Start, if this unit has 0 Green Slime, become Staggered and reduce the Pearl's Sin resistances by 0.5 each. When Stagger ends, gain 10 Green Slime.

passives.0.response.text: Focus the Pearl during the special Stagger opening. Distinguish this from ordinary Stagger and the Shell's resistances.

passives.1.effect.text: At Turn Start, if this unit has 0 Green Slime, become Staggered and reduce the Pearl's Sin resistances by 0.5 each. When Stagger ends, gain 10 Green Slime.

passives.1.response.text: Focus the Pearl during the special Stagger opening. Distinguish this from ordinary Stagger and the Shell's resistances.

passives.2.effect.text: Speed becomes 1 on turns using Devouring Fluid.

passives.2.response.text: Speed falls to 1, making it easier to remove summons before the boss acts.

passives.3.effect.text: Speed becomes 1 on turns using Devouring Fluid.

passives.3.response.text: Speed falls to 1, making it easier to remove summons before the boss acts.

passives.4.effect.text: The Shell Part retains its original resistances even while Staggered.

passives.4.response.text: The Shell retains its normal resistances, so prioritize focusing the Pearl.

passives.5.effect.text: When defeated by Ambling Pearl, grant 3 Green Slime.

passives.5.response.text: Defeat the slime with a faster Sinner to prevent replenishment of 3 stacks.

passives.6.effect.text: At Turn End, inflict Poison on all enemies equal to 2 + the number of living Green Slimes.

passives.6.response.text: Each surviving slime applies Poison. Do not leave them alone just because they have no actions.
